Class AmwpFrame

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.wire.AmwpFrame
public final class AmwpFrame extends Object
The AmwpFrame class is one decoded AMWP frame. AMWP is the framed protocol on the connection. The payload is the raw octets from the frame. The payload is not decoded as UTF-8. // @aa-sdd G-07 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md

  • Constructor Details

    • AmwpFrame

      public AmwpFrame(int channel, int type, int flags, byte[] payload)
      The constructor stores one decoded frame. A null payload is stored as a new empty array.
      Parameters:
      channel - The channel is the frame channel id.
      type - The type is the frame type byte.
      flags - The flags are the frame flag byte.
      payload - The payload is the raw octets, and a null array is stored empty.

    • getPayload

      public byte[] getPayload()
      The method returns the payload array stored on this frame. The array is the same array the constructor stored.
      Returns:
      The return value is the payload octets, and it is never null.

    • isFragment

      public boolean isFragment()
      The method reports whether the more-fragments flag is set. The flag is AmwpConstants.FLAG_FRAGMENT.
      Returns:
      The return value is true when that bit is set on the flag byte.
